hooks.command: if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); else cmd=$(cat); fi; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: update CLAUDE.md with the changes in this commit before committing. If you already did, proceed." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *frontend/app/*|*frontend/components/*|*.css) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read docs/DESIGN.md before making UI changes. It contains the canonical spec for colors, fonts, hero layout, category grid, ProducerCard, Footer, etc." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *backend/*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read docs/DATA.md before making backend changes. It contains the DB schema and API contract." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ ! -d "$root/frontend" ]; then echo "frontend/ not found at $root, skipping build"; exit 0; fi; set -o pipefail; cd "$root/frontend" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Frontend build failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''

hooks._comment: PERMANENT defensive backend pytest hook. The WHY lives in the `#` comment header INSIDE the command string below (bash script) so it travels with the hook even if this sibling `_comment` field gets stripped by a schema validator. Do NOT replace with a one-line `pytest ... || block` pattern — that falsely blocks every sandbox that lacks pytest or the tests/ subtree.
hooks.command:
bash -c '# =====================================================================
# PERMANENT defensive backend pytest hook — DO NOT simplify back to a
# one-line `pytest ... || block` pattern. That was tried repeatedly and
# breaks every sandbox session that lacks pytest (Claude Code on the web,
# partial clones, etc.) by treating absent-test-infra as failed-tests.
#
# Guards below gracefully degrade; block ONLY on real test failures:
#   1. pytest CLI not available -> warn + exit 0  (sandbox case)
#   2. backend/ missing         -> warn + exit 0  (wrong working dir)
#   3. test_api.py missing      -> warn + exit 0  (partial clone)
#   4. tests fail for real      -> emit decision:block JSON
#   5. tests pass               -> exit 0 (default)
#
# `python -m pytest --version` is a STRONGER check than `import pytest`
# because it validates the full CLI is wired up, not just that the
# package happens to be importable.
# =====================================================================
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
if ! python -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Warning: pytest not available in this environment, skipping backend tests"
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -d "$root/backend" ]; then
  echo "Warning: backend/ not found at $root, skipping backend tests"
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -f "$root/backend/tests/test_api.py" ]; then
  echo "Warning: backend/tests/test_api.py not found, skipping backend tests"
  exit 0
fi
cd "$root/backend"
set -o pipefail
if ! python -m pytest tests/test_api.py -q 2>&1 | tail -20; then
  echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Backend tests failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"'
fi
'
